title: ModuleManifest
description: module.yaml — manifest plus declarative rules (SPEC-0 §5.2). Strict: unknown top-level keys are an error, not a warning (REQ MOD-014).

name.description: Slug. Must equal the module directory name and be unique in the library.

pporlock_api.description: Module API major version the module targets (SPEC-0 §8.1). An unsupported value refuses to load with a clear message (REQ MOD-026).

enabled.description: Creating or updating a module never enables it (REQ MCP-030); enabling is a separate explicit action.

priority.description: Lower runs earlier. Orders rules across modules (SPEC-0 §5.4).
